sections.h2: Shelled almonds pay a ₹100 per kilo duty against ₹35 for in-shell

chart.title: The duty on kernels is the reason almonds arrive still in their shells
chart.sub: Basic customs duty, ₹ per kilo, for in-shell and shelled almond tariff lines.

sections.means: Duty is levied per kilo on the weight crossing the border, so shipping shells is cheaper than paying duty on kernels.
